description:
Our client, an international law firm, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Banking Paralegal to join its team in Hong Kong.

Key Responsibilities:
You’ll support lawyers on matters including:

- Preparing engagement documentation and supporting client onboarding and matter opening processes.
- Coordinating and tracking conditions precedent requirements and transaction deliverables.
- Compiling and organising transaction records, closing files and electronic deal bibles.
- Preparing corporate filings, registration documents and other statutory submissions.
- Drafting corporate authorities, board resolutions and other ancillary transaction documents.

What We’re Looking For:

- Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB) or equivalent from a recognised university.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
- A genuine interest in developing expertise within banking, financial regulation and structured finance.

To apply for the above position, please submit your resume in Word file by clicking "APPLY NOW" below or contact Joanne Goh on j.goh@alsrecruit.com for further information.
